Campus life / GUIDE 04

Turn a room into a routine.

This is a suggested student checklist, not an official housing policy. Use your assigned residence’s current instructions for move-in dates, permitted items, payments, and building rules.

Reviewed 2026-11-16 · Unofficial student guide

01

Read your move-in instructions

Confirm your assigned building, check-in arrangements, required documents, and any instructions sent by the university. Ask the housing contact if something is unclear.

02

Pack for the actual room

Check what is provided before buying bedding, adapters, or storage. Bring essentials first and make a second shopping list after you see the space.

03

Agree on shared-space habits

Discuss sleep schedules, cleaning, guests, and noise with roommates. Follow the residence rules when making your agreement.

04

Report problems early

Record existing damage and ask the residence staff how to request repairs. Keep the building’s contact details somewhere easy to find.

Small things that help

  • Label shared items and agree before borrowing.
  • Avoid buying appliances before checking what your residence permits.
